description:
Canonical plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md

Objective
Contributors can find each Jido test, fixture, and proof by purpose and owning Jido.* namespace without understanding former package layouts.

Scope
Reorganize the complete test tree after jido-nnq closes. Consolidate shared support and property evidence infrastructure. Remove only proven duplication. Update active path consumers atomically.

Technical direction
Use purpose-first, namespace-second paths; one compiled test/support root; production Jido.* namespaces for executable tests; Jido.Test.* for helpers and fixtures; one configured property evidence pipeline; serial integration without compatibility paths.

Definition of done
All seven plan units are closed in dependency order. Required offline and quality gates pass. Covenant IDs and obligation counts remain stable. Retired active paths and test-only namespaces are absent. Final test-tree duplication is below the recorded post-jido-nnq baseline.

Initial frontier
U1 is the first unit, but it remains blocked until the existing jido-nnq epic closes.
title: Organize the Jido test tree
